verdict.rationale: Supabase Realtime explicitly documents Presence ('Track and synchronize user state across clients... showing who's online') and Broadcast ('Send low-latency messages between clients' for cursor tracking, game events, custom notifications), and a co-founder's launch post confirms these shipped features running at scale on the Elixir/Phoenix realtime server. Community usage further corroborates real-world adoption (typing indicators, online presence use cases). Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of presence/broadcast latency or third-party tutorial beyond vendor docs and a single founder post.
